expression_comparison.chosen_because: Outright long duration fights the 97-99th percentile yield tape; AU-US RV is mid-history. Long AUDUSD isolates the pro-cyclical residual after those rates objects are considered.

considered_rates.assessment: US 10Y 4.94 is near the 1y 97.8th percentile with a 45.000000000000014bp 3m change; AU 2Y 4.835 sits at the 99.8th 1y percentile while Australian housing is tightening.
US 2s10s is 27.000000000000046bp at the 1.4th 1y percentile, so curve is an executable alternative to spot or outright duration.
CA-US 5Y is -122.00000000000001bp at the 0.2th 1y percentile — a historically extreme cross-market RV object.

considered_spot.assessment: AUDUSD 1y percentile is far less extreme than AU 2Y or US 2Y, so spot is the cleaner risk-on vehicle.

remit: strongest pro-growth, risk-on, cyclical FX expression
stance_summary: Growth/risk resilience is still cleaner in AUDUSD than in already-extreme global duration.

evidence_refs: rollup:Australian housing downturn deepens under higher rates
trade.invalidation: Packet-updated evidence of a US activity/labor break or a fresh official AU hard-landing print.
trade.mispricing: AUDUSD treats Australian housing and the Fed hike as a full risk-off reset while US activity/labor gauges remain warm and AUDUSD is only mid-to-upper 1y history.
trade.thesis: Cyclical AUD still expresses under-discounted growth/risk continuity better than owning 98th-percentile global yields.
why_now: Frozen packet cutoff keeps the post-FOMC risk-reset and AU housing scare simultaneous.
